clo-po-calc-aligned.label: ALIGNED
clo-po-calc-aligned.sourceQuote: Apply knowledge of mathematics and science to solve complex engineering problems
clo-po-calc-aligned.targetQuote: Apply differentiation rules to solve optimization problems in engineering
clo-po-calc-aligned.explanation: The CLO applies differentiation (mathematics) to solve engineering optimization problems, matching the PO's verb, level and subject.

clo-po-calc-lower-level.label: NOT_ALIGNED
clo-po-calc-lower-level.sourceQuote: Design solutions for complex engineering problems that meet specified needs
clo-po-calc-lower-level.targetQuote: Define the derivative of a function
clo-po-calc-lower-level.explanation: The PO asks for Create-level design of solutions to complex engineering problems meeting specified needs. The CLO only says 'Define' (Remember level), so the verb and level are far below the PO. It has no engineering problem, no solution and no specified needs, so the subject is also missing. It is only a calculus topic word (derivative).
clo-po-calc-lower-level.draft: Design solutions to engineering problems that meet specified needs by modeling them as functions and applying derivatives to optimize the result.

clo-po-calc-unrelated.label: NOT_ALIGNED
clo-po-calc-unrelated.sourceQuote: Communicate effectively with a range of audiences
clo-po-calc-unrelated.explanation: The PO is about communicating effectively with a range of audiences. The CLO is about evaluating limits of rational functions, a purely mathematical computation. It has no communication verb, no audience and no communication subject. Its level (Evaluate/Apply) is not the issue; the competency is unrelated.
clo-po-calc-unrelated.draft: Communicate the results of limit and derivative analyses of engineering problems clearly to technical and non-technical audiences through written reports and oral explanations.

clo-po-calc-vague.label: PARTIALLY_ALIGNED
clo-po-calc-vague.sourceQuote: Apply knowledge of mathematics and science to solve complex engineering problems
clo-po-calc-vague.explanation: The CLO 'Understand calculus' is Understand level, lower than the PO's Apply. It has no action verb to apply or solve anything. It has no engineering problems as its object, and 'calculus' is only a topic word that is too vague to show mathematics applied to engineering.
clo-po-calc-vague.draft: Apply differentiation rules and limit concepts of calculus to solve engineering problems.
